blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Victoria is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 101 homes sold there: 36 houses, 31 condos, 13 townhomes and 21 duplexes. 36 houses sold in Victoria with a median price of $1,528,000 (the middle half sold between $1,418,750 and $1,842,500), taking a median of 9 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 22% sold above list.
Victoria home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

36 houses sold in Victoria with a median price of $1,528,000 (the middle half sold between $1,418,750 and $1,842,500), taking a median of 9 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 22% sold above list. They had a median $709 per square foot, a median year built of 1962 and a median lot of 4,026 square feet. 31 condos sold in Victoria with a median price of $533,000 (the middle half sold between $491,770 and $665,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 13% sold above list. They had a median $822 per square foot, a median year built of 2011 and a median strata fee of $454 a month.

items.t: Victoria-Fraserview is a City local area running from 41st Avenue south to the Fraser River and from Knight Street west to Earles, Vivian and Elliot Streets east.
Kensington-Cedar Cottage is the City local area to the north: Fraser Street to Nanaimo Street, with 41st Avenue as its southern edge.
Trout Lake sits inside John Hendry Park at East 15th Avenue and Victoria Drive, in Kensington-Cedar Cottage.
Victoria-Fraserview has more ground-oriented housing than the city average; apartments were about 25% of stock, all under five storeys (2016 census data).
Kensington-Cedar Cottage had about 44% renter households and about 30% apartments, with a high concentration of semi-detached and duplex housing (2016 data).
The City's R1-1 zone consolidated nine low-density RS zones, about 65,000 lots.
Under R1-1, duplexes and single detached houses are outright; multiple dwellings (up to 8 units) are conditional and need rear-lane access and a site outside a designated flood plain.

blocks.text: Victoria: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Kensington Community Centre is at Knight Street and East 37th Avenue, with a 15-metre indoor pool, fitness centre, seniors' centre and skateboard park.
John Hendry Park covers 27.21 hectares, includes the Trout Lake Community Centre and a 1.2 km path around the lake.
Lord Selkirk Elementary, 1750 East 22nd Avenue, K-7, in Kensington-Cedar Cottage.
Lord Selkirk Annex, 4444 Dumfries Street, K-4.
Neither VSB page states a catchment; both link a school locator.
TransLink's N20 night route is titled "Victoria" and runs between Howe at Dunsmuir and Marine Drive Station, with a stop at Victoria and 41 Avenue.

items.t: R1-1 multiple-dwelling eligibility excludes designated flood plain sites (see above).

The Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy applies citywide to rezoning and development permit applications affecting renters; it replaced the Rate of Change Guidelines for applications received from February 15, 2016.

faq.q: What did homes in Victoria sell for?
faq.a: 36 houses sold in Victoria from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $1,528,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Victoria?
faq.a: The median was 9 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (22% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Victoria sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 36 houses that sold in Victoria went for between $1,418,750 and $1,842,500, around a median of $1,528,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Victoria sell above asking price?
faq.a: 22% of the 36 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.4% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Victoria?
faq.a: The median year built was 1962 for the 36 houses sold in Victoria.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Victoria usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Victoria had 5 bedrooms, from the 36 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
